Provides a one central view for keeping your Linux fleet healthy, secure, and consistently configured.
Automates tedious IT tasks, freeing up your time.
Upstream of Multi-Linux Manager, backed by SUSE.
💻  Automated Patch & Package Management: Keep systems up-to-date and secure with ease.
